description: This file defines the I18NTranslationBulkAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for bulk updating internationalization (i18n) translation strings within an administrative module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes method implementations for updating translation data, validation rules for request parameters, and annotations describing the API's OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: I18NTranslationBulkAPI
